Class SpawnScreen

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.StackPane
gamemode.lobby.Scene.SpawnScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class SpawnScreen extends javafx.scene.layout.StackPane
SpawnScreen represents the main lobby screen where the player spawns.

This screen acts as the central hub of the game where the player can:

  • View player money
  • View player level and experience bar
  • Open the inventory
  • Open the shop
  • Open the sell menu

The screen uses a StackPane layout and layers multiple UI components including SpawnCanvas, SellScene, ShopScene, and InventoryPane.

It interacts with the GameLogic singleton to retrieve player information such as money, level, and experience.

Keyboard shortcut:

  • TAB → Toggle inventory
